confirmatory_status: method-amended exploratory analysis; it does not rescue the failed preregistered global effect-size threshold
reason: In fragmented 10x 3-prime libraries, aligned fragment boundaries form broad occupancy distributions and must not be interpreted as cleavage coordinates.
inspected_before_freeze: pooled-kernel PolyASite mixture primary and sensitivity/null arms

model.candidate_identity: PolyASite 2.0 site in a unique same-strand GENCODE v49 terminal-exon union extended 2000 bp transcript-downstream
model.internal_priming: drop candidates with at least 12 A in downstream 20 nt or an 8-A run in downstream 140 nt
model.kernel_smoothing: five-bin moving sum plus one pseudocount per bin
model.cross_fitting: each donor is deconvolved with a kernel learned from the other seven donors
model.em: maximum 50 iterations, stop at maximum mixture-weight change below 1e-8
model.inference: unchanged paired donor t test, exact sign-flip calibration, BH correction, effect/concordance/leave-one-out gates

controls.shuffle_gate: zero reported genes and no global directional pass
controls.stability_gate: at least 80 percent of gap-24 reported genes retain effect sign at both neighboring gaps
controls.heldout_kernel_gate: positive predictive gain over a uniform distance model in every donor
controls.performance_gate: at most 90 seconds and 8 GiB; at least 2-fold faster or smaller than eight legacy apa-test scans

claim_guard: A PolyASite candidate is an orthogonally catalogued polyadenylation site; a Gravlax fragment endpoint is not called a cleavage site.
